claim: When you create an HTTPS listener on an Application Load Balancer, you must specify exactly one certificate, known as the default certificate; a certificate list lets the load balancer support multiple domains on the same port with a different certificate for each domain, and the load balancer selects a certificate with support for SNI.

evidence.quote: When you create an HTTPS listener, you must specify exactly one certificate. This certificate is known as the *default certificate*.
evidence.title: SSL certificates for your Application Load Balancer

evidence.quote: Using a certificate list enables the load balancer to support multiple domains on the same port and provide a different certificate for each domain.
The load balancer uses a smart certificate selection algorithm with support for SNI.
